idea-plugin.name: Markdown Review
idea-plugin.description:
Review changes to Markdown files in rendered form, right inside IntelliJ's own diff window, instead of reading raw markup.

A text diff of Markdown shows syntax, not content: a rewritten paragraph turns into scattered red and green lines, a table edit becomes shifted | characters, and re-indenting a list looks like everything changed. Markdown Review shows the comparison the way the document looks once rendered.
  • Rendered side-by-side diff: headings, paragraphs, list items, table rows and code blocks aligned in rows; removed blocks on red, added on green, changed words highlighted.
  • Merged view: one column, removals struck through, additions in green.
  • Mermaid diagrams drawn offline, in the editor's light or dark theme; a changed diagram shows the old and the new drawing, with a toggle for the line diff of its source.
  • Moved blocks are labeled at both ends, with a link to the other end, and revert as a move.
  • Math ($...$, $$...$$) drawn offline with KaTeX; a changed formula is highlighted as a whole.
  • Per-block revert and apply: buttons on a changed block copy it to the other side, through the IDE document, so Undo works.
  • Block menu: right-click a block to go to its source, open the text diff at its line (where pull request windows take review comments) or show the history of just that block.
  • Block source editing: double-click a block to edit its raw Markdown in place; saved as one Undo step.
  • Export the rendered diff as a standalone HTML file (no scripts, images inlined) or a PDF, to attach to a review or a ticket.
  • Custom stylesheet: a CSS file of your own on top of the rendered view, for example to match your documentation site.
  • Text diff one click away in the diff window's viewer switcher.
  • Works for local changes (Commit window), file history, branch comparison and pull requests, plus Compare Markdown Files... for any two files.
  • F7 and Shift+F7 move between changes; Ctrl/Cmd+click on a block opens its source in the editor.
  • GitHub Flavored Markdown: tables, task lists, strikethrough, autolinks, footnotes and alerts, plus HTML blocks, <details>, HTML comments, hard line breaks, emoji shortcodes and YAML front matter.
  • Settings | Tools | Markdown Review picks the viewer a Markdown diff opens with and how readily a rewritten block is paired with its old version, and holds the whitespace, collapse-unchanged, large-file, remote-image, Mermaid and math options. The diff colors are set per color scheme in Settings | Editor | Color Scheme | Markdown Review.
Free for noncommercial use and maintained in spare time. If it saves you time in reviews, help cover the AI token budget behind new features and fixes on ❤ GitHub Sponsors or ☕ Ko-fi.

Requires an IntelliJ-based IDE 2025.1 or newer with JCEF (the default in JetBrains Runtime); without JCEF the text diff stays in place.

Free for noncommercial use under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0. Commercial use requires a separate license from the author. Source code and issues: github.com/agadek/markdown-review.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.1

  • Compatibility with IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3: block history and crash reports no longer use API that 2026.3 deprecates or marks as internal.

1.2.0

  • Math: $...$ and $$...$$ formulas are drawn offline with KaTeX; a changed formula is highlighted as a whole, and a changed block formula can show its source diff. Turn it off with the new Render math setting.
  • Moved blocks are labeled at both ends with a link to the other end, and reverting either end moves the block back in one Undo step.
  • Block source editing: double-click a block to edit its raw Markdown in place; saving is one Undo step.
  • Block menu: right-click a block to go to its source, open the text diff at its line or show the history of just that block.
  • Plugin errors reported from the IDE open a prefilled crash report on GitHub.

1.1.1

  • Links in the rendered diff whose scheme is written in upper or mixed case, such as HTTPS://, now open in the browser.

1.1.0

  • Expanded plugin description: why a rendered diff helps, navigation between changes and the supported IDE versions.
  • The rendered viewers have their own icons in the viewer switcher, which IntelliJ 2026.2 turned from a drop-down into a row of icon buttons; before, they showed the text viewer's icon.
  • Colors of added, removed and modified blocks and of changed words can be set per color scheme in Settings | Editor | Color Scheme | Markdown Review.

1.0.0

First release on JetBrains Marketplace.
  • Rendered side-by-side and merged diff viewers for Markdown files in IntelliJ's own diff window: Commit window, file history, branch comparison, pull requests and Compare Markdown Files....
  • Settings page (Settings | Tools | Markdown Review) with the default viewer for Markdown diffs, whitespace and collapse options, large-file limits, remote images, Mermaid and the pairing threshold.
  • Pairing threshold: how similar a removed and an added block must be to show as one modified block with a word diff.
  • Per-block revert and apply buttons on changed blocks of an editable side, each one Undo step.
  • Mermaid diagrams drawn offline in the editor's theme, with a "Show source changes" toggle on a changed diagram.
  • GitHub Flavored Markdown: tables, task lists, strikethrough, autolinks, footnotes and alerts.
  • HTML blocks and inline HTML (sanitized), <details> sections, HTML comments, hard line breaks, thematic breaks and emoji shortcodes.
  • A changed link target, heading level or alert type is marked as a change.
  • Relative images resolve against the file; remote images load only when enabled.
  • Very large files show a notice with an Open Text Viewer button instead of rendering.
  • Plugin icon for light and dark themes.
